subject: September updates: New tools and feature enhancements are live
body_text:
96 
 Simplify your portfolio setup and take advantage of new search filters. 
 See What’s New Across Seeking Alpha
 

 
 This month’s update features new tools that make it easier to set up your portfolio and streamline your research. From automatic imports to a ‘Strong Buy’ heat map and expanded AI filters, here’s what’s new:

 Market Data Heat Map
 

 Sifting through hundreds of tickers to find what actually matters can take time. The market data heat map makes it easier to spot the stocks and sectors worth your attention, so you can spend less time scanning and more time researching. Drill into a sector to see which industries have the most ‘Strong Buy’-rated stocks and quickly identify where to dig in next.

 The Market Data Heat Map is available on web only. 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 View the Heat Map 
 Automatic Portfolio Import 

 
Forget the manual entry—now you can create a new portfolio with a screenshot. Just upload the image (PDF and CSV files also work), and we’ll automatically identify your positions for you. Review the details, make any adjustments, and start tracking your watchlist on Seeking Alpha faster.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create a Portfolio 
 Expert-Curated Portfolios
 

 
Discover investment ideas faster with professionally curated portfolios built by Seeking Alpha. Explore themes like Top 10 Stocks, Top 10 Dividend Stocks, and Quant & SA Analyst Strong Buys, then add one (or many) to your account with just a few clicks. Start tracking expert-selected ideas immediately without spending time building a portfolio from scratch.

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Explore Portfolios 
 Expanded Ask Seeking Alpha Filters
 

 
Find more of what you're looking for with new screening capabilities in Ask Seeking Alpha. Search for Closed-End Funds (CEFs) using filters like discounts, premiums, and Seeking Alpha Analyst Ratings, or screen stocks using 10, 50, 100, and 200-day moving averages. Ask your question and get results in seconds.
